title: SafetyKit scales risk agents with OpenAI’s most capable models
summary: Discover how SafetyKit leverages OpenAI GPT-5 to enhance content moderation, enforce compliance, and outpace legacy safety systems with greater accuracy .
body: Discover how SafetyKit leverages OpenAI GPT-5 to enhance content moderation, enforce compliance, and outpace legacy safety systems with greater accuracy .
summaryZh: SafetyKit深度整合OpenAI最具能力的模型，用以扩展其风险智能体系统。该方案旨在显著提升内容审核的准确性，强制执行合规策略，并以极高的精度超越传统的旧式安全系统。原始信息显示：Discover how SafetyKit leverages OpenAI GPT-5 to enhance content moderation, enforce compliance, and outpace legacy safety systems with greater accuracy .。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“SafetyKit scales risk agents with OpenAI’s most capable models”。其重要性主要体现在：SafetyKit利用OpenAI的最强模型扩展风险智能体，增强内容审核与合规能力。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
